PLA PNG — the twelve fixes, in pictures

Every picture below is the PREVIEW build 2026-09-12 10:11 running your own branches. Your live planner is untouched.
PREVIEW planner (clickable) LIVE planner PNG layout mockup

how to use this page

Each card is numbered and stays numbered, so you can say approve 3, 9, 12 or reject 5 and I will know exactly which.

approve all ships the lot to the live planner. A card flips to shipped and leaves this page once it is live.

1

Outdent no longer hides the branch

waiting

"when I edit indent backward it removes the visual of the branch it’s from"

was wrong

A rule files any dated, titled, top-level item with no children into “Unbranched”. Outdent a branch’s last child and the branch itself matched that shape, so it was swallowed — and “Unbranched” is folded, so it looked deleted.

now

The branch stays where you left it. Guarded by shape, not by the one action you reported, so deleting the last child is covered too.

2

A date can be removed from the Edit button

waiting

"remove a date on a task, back to tree undated, a branch needn’t have a due date"

was wrong

Already built on 10 Sep — not part of last night’s batch.

now

Backspace the date field empty. The item leaves the calendar and stays in the tree. Works on a branch too. Re-verified today: 10/10 checks.

3

The clock gets the same calendar as the due date

waiting

"the clock sign must have the nice calendar as in due date, but one month, with today and tomorrow on top"

was wrong

The clock used the shared month grid, which had no quick chips.

now

TODAY and TOMORROW above the grid. One month, not two. Both pickers share one grid, so they cannot drift apart.

4

No duplicate "Untitled note"

waiting

"in the journal there’s a title AND untitled note, remove the duplicate"

was wrong

The placeholder drew beside the open note’s own title box.

now

An open note shows only its own title field.

5

Habits and Routines in the Location list

waiting

"have habits and routines in the Location section in the edit button"

was wrong

The Routines tab existed, but the two Location entries were never offered — a heading row I added with no padding made a later pass read them as children of a folded parent and delete them. Worse: “__habits” is not a tree id, so a Pick would have removed your task and pushed it to the top of the tree.

now

Both offered under “Or make it a”. Picking one converts the task and never moves it — nothing is deleted either way.

6

The note delete matches the regular delete

waiting

"in the note tab the delete button must be the same as the delete button in the regular section"

was wrong

A bare browser pop-up saying “cannot be undone”, while deleting a task opened the app’s own dialog and went to Deleted.

now

Same dialog, same two buttons, same destination — a note you delete by mistake comes back from Deleted, as a note. Also trimmed 520px → 277px: the tall box is a reservation for the tree’s two-step chain, and this is one step.

7

"Connect GitHub" is gone

waiting

"remove Connect GitHub, find what remnants need removing and let me know first"

was wrong

The gist held a second full copy of your planner, written by a second system while Firebase did the same job.

now

I did not delete the GitHub code — your iPhone calendar subscribes to a file inside that gist. Only the data half is off: the gist now holds a note saying so. Button reads “Calendar feed”.

8

A 3-dot menu on the right, with Sign out

waiting

"make a 3 dot menu all the way to the right with a sign out there"

was wrong

New. And your screenshot caught my miss: “Diagnose” sat to its right. My own check scanned <header>, which a module empties into another container — so it measured an empty element and could never fail.

now

Genuinely last, and it re-asserts the position because the bar is assembled by several modules at different times. It names the account you are signed in as.

9

The crescent is gone

waiting

"remove the crescent sign, only the black background, no light white background"

was wrong

A light/dark toggle sat on the bar.

now

Removed. One dark background. The light palette is left in the stylesheet rather than ripped out, so nothing referencing it breaks.

10

No indent arrows in the calendar menu

waiting

"the edit button in the calendar, remove the indentation there"

was wrong

The tree’s ← → indent arrows appeared in the calendar’s menu, where a block has no siblings to indent under.

now

Gone from the calendar, still there in the tree — checked both ways, because removing them everywhere would be a regression.

11

Mark complete greys out the item

waiting

"mark complete in the calendar is not working, it doesn’t grey out the item"

was wrong

Three separate faults. Calendar events always reported “not done”; a later wrapper rebuilt event entries and lost their time, so a timed event never even drew; and the blocks you can see never got a ⋮ button, because it was attached after a render that the day column re-filled afterwards.

now

Complete dims the block and strikes it through, like every other finished item.

12

The schedule is always 24 hours

waiting

"the 24 hours label on the top right, remove it, the schedule must always be 24 hours"

was wrong

A toggle that hid half the day by default.

now

Gone. The grid runs midnight to midnight, always.
